nodes.label: Mobile RoomList Refresh Fix
nodes.rationale: RoomListScreen only loaded on mount so returning from a room showed stale data; switching to useFocusEffect refetch (same pattern as ContactsScreen/MeScreen) fixes it. Server returns rooms created_at ASC so new chats fell off-screen; sorting by createdAt newest-first makes new conversations visible.

nodes.label: Mobile E2E Infrastructure Fixes
nodes.rationale: ATS NSAllowsArbitraryLoads is silently ignored on iOS 10+ when NSAllowsLocalNetworking is present, blocking the plaintext test server, so it was removed; Maestro flow-inline env blocks shadow the CLI -e OPC_SERVER_URL (seed always hit localhost), so the inline env was removed; suite switched to fail-fast with the unreliable 00-net-probe deleted.
